svg.title: New compute methodologies are required to drive significant improvement in AI performance.
svg.desc: Log-scale line chart of computing performance 1993–2030 (10 GigaFLOPS to 1 YottaFLOPS). Solid line: fastest supercomputer speed, rising from below 1 TFLOPS to about 0.25 ZFLOPS by 2030. Dashed line: AI training compute demand, diverging after 2024 to about 40 ZFLOPS by 2030; the shaded gap is the shortfall. Eras: A programmable GPUs and CUDA introduced; B deep learning breakthroughs with GPUs (from 2010); C transformers, LLMs and massive model scale-up (from 2020); D novel compute methodologies needed to bridge the gap (projection from 2026). Source: adapted from McKinsey & Company.
svg.text: New compute methodologies are required to drive significant improvement
